subject.title: feat: sidebar update card (web + macOS) with app-first mac update flow and Sparkle beta track

question: Should beta and dev macOS clients be enabled for the Sparkle beta channel before the public release workflow publishes beta appcast items?
rationale: The patch can generate and validate beta entries, but the current release workflow does not publish them; choosing whether to add publishing now or defer client exposure is a release-product decision rather than a safe review inference.

options.title: Publish beta items first
options.body: Add or land public beta appcast publication before enabling beta and dev clients to request that Sparkle channel.

options.title: Defer beta client exposure
options.body: Keep the stable app-first and sidebar work but postpone allowedChannels beta opt-in until publication exists.

recommendation.title: Publish beta items first
recommendation.body: Add or land public beta appcast publication before enabling beta and dev clients to request that Sparkle channel.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent appcast-generation and update-channel history makes this the strongest available routing candidate for the release-lane choice.
